data.description:
## Knowledge Needed
- Read: cortical/spark/ngram.py (understand train() and count accumulation)
- Read: cortical/spark/diff_tokenizer.py (tokenization of git diffs)
- Read: samples/memories/2025-12-27-knowledge-transfer-sparkslm-git-training.md

## Implementation
Create cortical/spark/git_trainer.py with:
1. GitHistoryTrainer class
2. WeightedCommit dataclass
3. Branch weight tier system (main=1.0, claude/*=0.4, etc.)
4. Quality signal detection (merged, tested, reverted)
5. Temporal decay computation

## Guardrails
- DO: Follow existing SparkSLM patterns in cortical/spark/
- DO: Use type hints and docstrings (Google style)
- DO: Deduplicate by SHA (each commit processed once)
- DO NOT: Modify NGramModel.train() yet (separate task)
- DO NOT: Add external dependencies
- EXPLORE: Consider generator-based streaming for memory efficiency
- EXPLORE: Whether to use Bloom filter vs Set for deduplication

## Success Criteria
- Class can compute weights for commits
- Deduplication works correctly
- All quality signals detected
- Unit tests pass

properties.retrospective: Created cortical/spark/git_trainer.py with GitHistoryTrainer and WeightedCommit classes. Added 40 tests with 97% coverage.
